newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma outlines 1998 budget procedures.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma outlines 1998 budget procedures.

text.p: Russia's State Duma lower house of parliament passed on Wednesday a bill outlining the timetable and procedures for passing the 1998 budget in four readings.

The government must submit the draft 1998 budget to the Duma by August 26 this year. The government must accompany the budget draft with a forecast of Russia's social and economic development for 1998.
The central bank must submit its draft 1998 monetary policy programme to the Duma by October 1, 1997.
The Duma will form a commission to consider the draft budget and make changes to tax laws.
It must pass the draft budget in a first reading within 40 days of its submission.

If the Duma rejects the draft budget, it will pass to a reconciliation commission consisting of deputies from the Duma and Federation Council upper house and government officials. The Duma can return the draft to be improved or move a no confidence motion in the government.
The second reading must be completed within 20 days of the first one. The third reading is to be completed within a further 30 days, and a fourth reading must follow within 10 days.
